store.summary: Join your tailnet with one tap, just like the phone app
store.description: Tailputer Zero gives the CardputerZero a single, big Connect/Disconnect button for Tailscale -- the same one-tap experience as the Android/iOS Tailscale app. When Tailscale needs you to sign in, it renders the login link as a QR code so you can approve it from your phone's camera instead of fighting the device's keyboard. Shows your tailnet IP and peer count once connected, plus a Devices page listing every tailnet peer with online status, and a Network Check page for diagnosing connectivity. Requires Tailscale to already be installed and a small helper script authorized via SSH first -- see the project README for the one-time setup (the app itself never runs as root).
